status_meaning.reviewed: The named official source was read; this is not an implementation pass.
status_meaning.documented: The local rule and adaptation are written.
status_meaning.mapped-not-executed: Existing owning code/tests or documentation were identified; no fresh runtime result is claimed.
status_meaning.excluded: The official requirement is deliberately not adopted, with a recorded local reason.
status_meaning.not-tested-in-this-package: Per-interface rule acceptance is not closed by documentation review or automated regression checks.
